# Thothica

> Hard problems can be solved when people understand their data. Thothica helps them do that by building ontologies and AI-native software. Thothica is an AI startup: it builds ontologies, and software on top of them, so staff and AI systems work from the same definitions of an organization's data.

Thothica (legal name: Thothica Private Limited) is an AI startup based in New Delhi, India, founded in 2023. Its discipline is data ontology. Contact: hello@thothica.com. This file describes the single-page site so that LLMs and crawlers can understand it without rendering the page.

## What Thothica does

Thothica builds ontologies, and it builds software on top of them. An ontology is a precise written record of what an organization's data means. It states what each item is, how the items relate to one another, and who is responsible for each decision. When software runs on an ontology, staff and AI systems work from the same definitions, and the organization no longer depends on a few experienced people to interpret its data. It can then solve, at scale, the problems those people used to solve one at a time.

## What Thothica builds

- Approval systems for governments. The software checks each application against every requirement, shows the applicant what is missing, and shows the official what is ready for a decision. Approvals move faster because everyone can see what is pending.
- For one state government in India, Thothica built the AI layer that now runs on five live portals. The layer reads each portal's own records and answers officials' questions from them, and it cannot change the underlying system.
- AI layers integrated into legacy software. The existing system stays as it is. The layer reads the system's data, explains it in plain language, and answers questions that staff would otherwise answer by searching through many screens and files.
- For a think tank, Thothica rebuilt an archive of more than 1,000 historical works that ran on a slow, outdated website. It is now a fast digital library. Researchers can search it in five languages, and every answer points back to the original document.
- Falsafa.ai (https://falsafa.ai), Thothica's open-source library of the world's philosophical, classical and religious texts. It holds more than 2,000 works, split into more than 1.3 million passages. People and AI systems can search the library and quote it with exact citations.
- Research-based graphic stories produced at scale. The software keeps the characters and the drawing style consistent from page to page, and it checks every statement in the story against a source.

## Who Thothica works with

Thothica works with some of India's largest publishers, with state governments, and with leading think tanks and small businesses.

Tell Thothica your hardest problem. It will solve it.
